words.tr: phrase. 交朋友；建立友谊；与人结交
words.ex: He wants to make friends at school.
words.en: To establish a relationship of mutual affection with someone, typically one that is not a romantic or family relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐了解；认识并熟悉
words.ex: I want to get to know you better.
words.en: To become familiar with someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.ex: Please write your full name on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请在表格上写下你的全名。
words.en: The complete name of a person, including their first name and surname, and sometimes any middle names.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: His last name is Smith.
words.en: Your last name is the name that you share with other members of your family. In English-speaking countries, it is usually at the end of your full name.

words.ex: My classmate helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的同班同学帮我做了作业。
words.en: A classmate is someone who is in the same class as you at school or college.

words.tr: phrase. 班主任；负责一个班级的教师
words.ex: The class teacher gives homework every day.
words.en: A class teacher is a teacher who is responsible for a particular class in a school.

words.ex: My first name is Tom.
words.en: Your first name is the name that was given to you when you were born and that comes before your family name.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.ex: He has the same book as me.
words.ex_cn: 他有一本和我一样的书。
words.en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

words.tr:
n. 双胞胎之一；
adj. 成对的；
words.ex: He has a twin brother who looks exactly like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个和他长得一模一样的双胞胎兄弟。
words.en: One of two children or animals born at the same birth; to pair or match closely.

words.tr:
adj. 两者的；
pron. 两者；
conj. 不仅…而且...；
words.ex: Both books are on the table.
words.en: You use both to refer to two things or people together.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.ex: He eats a lot of ice cream.
words.en: A large number or amount; a great deal.

words.ex: He eats tofu for dinner every day.
words.en: A soft, bland, white cheese-like food made from the pressed curds of soybean milk.

words.ex: The parrot can say hello.
words.en: A parrot is a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly colored feathers. Parrots are often kept as pets because they can be taught to copy human speech.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: Hey, can you help me with this?
words.en: used to attract attention or to express surprise, interest, or annoyance

words.ex: He loves to play the guitar in his free time.
words.ex_cn: v. 他喜欢在空闲时间弹吉他。
words.en: To play the guitar means to perform music on a guitar by strumming or plucking its strings.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.ex: I would like to eat an apple.
words.en: Used to express a polite desire or preference for something.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: He reads books as a hobby.
words.en: A hobby is an activity that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.ex: He is from the UK.
words.en: The United Kingdom, a sovereign state in northwestern Europe.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一次测验。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.tr: phrase. 火锅；一种将薄片食材在滚烫汤底中涮煮的中式烹饪方式
words.ex: We eat hot pot with friends on cold nights.
words.ex_cn: 我们在寒冷的夜晚和朋友吃火锅。
words.en: A dish consisting of a simmering metal pot of stock at the center of the dining table, with a variety of raw ingredients placed beside it to be cooked in the pot.

words.ex: She lives in Sydney.
words.en: Sydney is a major city in Australia, known for its harbourfront Opera House with a distinctive sail-like design, and the massive Darling Harbour and the smaller Circular Quay port, hubs of waterside life.

words.ex: She moved to Australia last year.
words.ex_cn: 她去年搬到了澳大利亚。
words.en: A country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania, and numerous smaller islands.

words.tr: phrase. 麻婆豆腐（四川传统名菜，以豆腐、牛肉末或猪肉末、豆瓣酱、花椒等烹制而成，麻辣鲜香）
words.ex: He likes to eat mapo tofu with rice.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢用米饭吃麻婆豆腐。
words.en: A spicy Sichuan dish made with tofu, minced meat, and fermented black beans in a chili-oil sauce.

words.tr: phrase. 北京烤鸭，一种著名的中国菜肴，以烤制酥脆的鸭皮和嫩滑的鸭肉著称
words.ex: I tried Beijing roast duck for the first time last night and it was delicious.
words.ex_cn: n. 昨晚我第一次尝试北京烤鸭，非常美味。
words.en: Beijing roast duck is a famous dish from Beijing, known for its thin, crispy skin, with authentic versions of the dish serving mostly the skin and little meat, sliced in front of the diners by the cook.

words.ex: He lives in Singapore.
words.en: A country in Southeast Asia, known for its multicultural society, strict laws, and as a global financial hub.

words.ex: He lives in London.
words.en: London is the capital city of England and the United Kingdom, known for its history, culture, and financial services.
